questions.question: A northeast development forum met in Imphal on 4th April and Guwahati two days after. What was Guwahati's date?
questions.questionHtml: A northeast development forum met in Imphal on 4th April and Guwahati two days after. What was Guwahati's date?
questions.solution:
The forum met in Imphal on 4th April.
It met in Guwahati two days after.

Add 2 days to April 4:

4 April + 2 days = 6 April

questions.question: If 3 * 2 = 11, 4 * 5 = 21, 6 * 3 = 39, then 5 * 2 = ?
questions.solution:
Logic: a * b = a2 + b

3 * 2 = 11 → 32 + 2 = 9 + 2 = 11

4 * 5 = 21 → 42 + 5 = 16 + 2 = 21

Similarly,

5 * 2 = ? → 52 + 2 = 25 + 2 = 27

questions.question: A statement is given followed by two conclusions. Find which conclusion is FALSE based on the given statement. Statement: P ≥ T; Q = R ≥ U; V ≥ R > S; T ≥ Q Conclusions: I: V ≥ Q II: P > S
questions.questionHtml:
A statement is given followed by two conclusions. Find which conclusion is FALSE based on the given statement.

Statement: P ≥ T; Q = R ≥ U; V ≥ R > S; T ≥ Q

Conclusions:

I: V ≥ Q

II: P > S
questions.solution:
Conclusions:
I: V ≥ Q - True (As, V ≥ R = Q ≥ U → V ≥ Q)
II: P > S - False (As, P ≥ T ≥ Q = R > S → P > S)

Thus, Neither I nor II is False.

questions.question: Which roll number has only prime digits?
questions.questionHtml: Which roll number has only prime digits?
questions.solution:
1. 239 → 9 is not a prime number.

3. 468 → 4, 6 and 8 are not prime numbers.

4. 579 → 9 is not a prime number.

Thus, 357 has only prime digits.

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the action that follows. Statement: Cases of online fraud have increased rapidly. Course of Action: 1. Introduce mandatory cyber awareness training. 2. Remove all online payment options.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the action that follows.
Statement: Cases of online fraud have increased rapidly.
Course of Action:
1. Introduce mandatory cyber awareness training.
2. Remove all online payment options.
questions.solution:
Course of Action:

1. Introduce mandatory cyber awareness training. - Follows (Because, this is a practical and preventive measure. Educating people about online safety can reduce fraud.)

2. Remove all online payment options. - Does not follows (Because, this is not practical. Online payments are essential in modern systems, and removing them is unrealistic.)

Thus, only 1 follows.

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: All men are humans. Some humans are women. Conclusions: I. Some men are women. II. All women are humans.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.
Statement:
All men are humans. Some humans are women.
Conclusions:
I. Some men are women.
II. All women are humans.
questions.solution:
Conclusions:
I. Some men are women. - False (There is no definite relation between men and women, it can be true but it is not definite)
II. All women are humans. - False (Because, Some humans are women, which means some women are humans.)

Thus, neither I nor II follows.

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: Some M are N. All N are O. No O is P. Conclusions: I. Some M are O. II. Some N are not P.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.
Statement:
Some M are N. All N are O. No O is P.
Conclusions:
I. Some M are O.
II. Some N are not P.
questions.solution:
Conclusions:
I. Some M are O. - True (Because, Some M are N. All N are O, which means some M being N are O.)
II. Some N are not P. - True (Because,  All N are O. No O is P, which means All N being O are not P. Thus, some N are not P)

Thus, both I and II follow.

questions.question: What is the 12th term of 5, 10, 15, ...?
questions.questionHtml: What is the 12th term of 5, 10, 15, ...?
questions.solution:
Given:

Sequence = 5, 10, 15, ...

Formula used:

nth term of AP = a + (n − 1)d

Calculation:

a = 5

d = 5

n = 12

⇒ T12 = 5 + (12 − 1) × 5

⇒ 5 + 11 × 5

⇒ 5 + 55

⇒ 60

∴ 12th term = 60.

questions.solution:

dog → pqr

fish → yz

cat → stu

Thus, the code for 'dog fish cat' is 'pqr, yz, stu'.
